WORK_REF=refs/heads/codex/react-fastapi-base-golden-ui-v2-rc21-postfix-evidence-recovery-v8

rtk git fetch origin main --prune
HEAD_SHA=$(rtk git rev-parse HEAD)
HEAD_TREE=$(rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^{tree})
MAIN_SHA=$(rtk git rev-parse origin/main)
MAIN_TREE=$(rtk git rev-parse origin/main''^{tree})
WORK_REMOTE=$(rtk git ls-remote origin "$WORK_REF" | rtk proxy awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
R7_REMOTE="'$(rtk git ls-remote origin "$R7_REF" | rtk proxy awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
R8_REMOTE="'$(rtk git ls-remote origin "$R8_REF" | rtk proxy awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')

if rtk proxy git diff --quiet "$MAIN" -- VERSION frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json; then VERSION_LOCK_UNCHANGED=true; else VERSION_LOCK_UNCHANGED=false; fi
printf '"'%s\\n' \"r8_source_sha="'$HEAD_SHA"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"r8_tree_sha="'$HEAD_TREE"

printf '"'%s\\n' \"r8_work_branch_local="'$HEAD_SHA"

printf '"'%s\\n' \"r7_remote="'$R7_REMOTE"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"r8_remote="'$R8_REMOTE"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"source_changed="'$SOURCE_CHANGED"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"index_clean="'$INDEX_CLEAN"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"worktree_clean="'$WORKTREE_CLEAN"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"version_package_lock_unchanged="'$VERSION_LOCK_UNCHANGED"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"version="'$(rtk git show HEAD:VERSION)"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"frontend_package_version="'$(rtk git show HEAD:frontend/package.json | rtk jq -r .version)"
printf '"'%s\\n' \"native_deterministic_ref="'$(rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/codex-fabric/evidence/react-fastapi-base/golden-ui-v2-rc21-postfix-evidence-recovery-v8 | rtk proxy awk '"'{print "'$1}'"' || true)\""
